find_instance_center: find instance center points from a center heatmap using thresholding and non-maximum suppression
group_pixels: group image pixels into instance IDs by assigning each pixel to its nearest detected center point
get_instance_segmentation: get class-agnostic instance segmentation masks from semantic labels, center heatmap, and offset predictions
merge_semantic_and_instance: merge semantic segmentation labels with instance segmentation to produce panoptic segmentation output
get_panoptic_segmentation: compute panoptic segmentation by combining semantic labels, center heatmap, and offsets into a unified prediction
